inputs.name: Build cost per home passed
inputs.source: Airtel CEO, Q2 FY26 call (4 Nov 2025): "$28-32 cost per home pass"; converted at Rs 95.1 per dollar from Airtel's own report. Downside Rs 6,000 sits between that and the Rs 8,500 all-in ceiling from FY26 Homes capex divided by passes added.

inputs.name: Cost to connect a customer
inputs.source: Airtel CEO, Aug 2022: $30-35 per home connection, "blended under $30" in cities. Dated; no newer figure is published.

inputs.name: Acquisition cost per new customer
inputs.source: Not published by any operator. Proxy: the Rs 1,000 installation fee Airtel waives on 3, 6 and 12-month plans.

inputs.name: Customers replaced each month
inputs.source: Not published by any Indian operator. Each replaced customer costs a new connection and acquisition. Airtel says customers who also take Airtel mobile churn about half as much.

inputs.name: Monthly revenue per customer
inputs.source: Airtel Homes ARPU Rs 523, Q1 FY27 (Apr-Jun 2026). Downside Rs 470 = GTPL broadband ARPU, a regional cable-ISP level. Upside Rs 572 = Airtel Homes ARPU in Jun 2024.

inputs.name: Contribution margin
inputs.source: Airtel Homes segment EBITDA margin 49.1%, Q1 FY27, used as a stand-in for contribution. Downside 40% allows for partner revenue share (Airtel offers cable operators up to 35%).

inputs.name: Customers per 100 passes at 24 months
inputs.source: Airtel CEO, Nov 2025: fibre utilisation "28-30% over a couple of years". Airtel's whole network today runs at about 24 fibre customers per 100 passes (derived: 10.9 million fibre customers on 45 million passes). Downside 18% assumes new and contested localities convert below the network average.

definitions.name: TRAI wired broadband
definitions.note: Fibre, cable, DSL, Ethernet, leased lines; every ISP. The base for shares in this tab.

definitions.name: TRAI wireline telephone lines
definitions.note: The only table by circle; includes Tata Tele's 11.2 million mostly business lines; excludes ISP-only operators.

definitions.name: Jio "fixed broadband"
definitions.note: JioFiber plus AirFiber; about half is fixed wireless.

definitions.name: Airtel "Homes customers"
definitions.note: Fibre plus AirFiber; Airtel does not split them (TRAI shows 3.82 million Airtel 5G fixed wireless).

definitions.name: Analyst "home broadband"
